reply_text:
I’d block on one issue:

*P1 — Team and archive plans reject every nonempty upload* (`src/plans.js:11`). `entry.quotaKiB << 10` uses JavaScript’s signed 32-bit bitwise arithmetic, so both larger quotas become **0 bytes**, rather than 200 GiB and 2 TiB. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty account for both plans.

Use numeric multiplication (`entry.quotaKiB * 1024`) and add quota/upload regression tests for both plans before merging.

All four existing tests pass; they only exercise the free-plan quota. No code changed.
